blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text:
The amount of work done in stretching a material is equal to the average force applied multiplied by the distance moved.
Therefore, the area under a force-extension graph represents the work done to stretch the material. Work done to stretch the material is also equal to elastic P.E. stored in the material.
